start: Money page, a member has dues

steps.action: Open Money
user_sees: Title 'Money', line 'Every rupee that came in', tabs 'Collections' and 'Dues'; this month's receipts and totals
must_not: A cancelled receipt counted as money received
A total that differs from the sum of the receipts shown

steps.action: Tap 'Dues'
user_sees: 'All money still due to the gym', tile 'Total due' with '{n} members', age-group tiles, 'Download Excel file', a 'Collect' button on each row
must_not: Archived members' dues left out of 'Total due'
A fully paid membership on the list

steps.action: Tap Collect on a row, leave the amount empty (the full due), pick the method, tap save
user_sees: The collect sheet for that member with the oldest unpaid membership picked
The sheet closes; the row leaves Dues; the receipt is offered for printing
must_not: Two receipts for one save
Amount above the due accepted
Receipt with no name of who took the money
A date ahead of today accepted

steps.action: Open the receipt, tap Print, then send it on WhatsApp
user_sees: Page 'Receipt {number}' with '{member} · {day}', buttons 'Back', WhatsApp and Print; the message says what is still due
must_not: Another member's amount on the receipt
WhatsApp button for a cancelled receipt
A receipt number shown as sure before the save reached the server

start: Money page, signed in as front desk, a member has dues

steps.action: Open Money
user_sees: Title 'Money', line 'Who still has fees to pay', no tabs, no 'Total due' tiles and no 'Download Excel file'; the list of people with a 'Collect' button each
must_not: Any money total, chart or export for staff
The Collections tab reachable by typing /money or /money/today

steps.action: Tap Collect, type a part amount, pick a date 5 days back, save
user_sees: Sheet closes; the member stays on the list with the smaller due; the receipt names this staff person as the taker
must_not: A date more than 31 days back accepted
Receipt saved under the owner's name
The server refusing after the sheet said saved

steps.action: Open the receipt and print it
user_sees: 'Receipt {number}' page with Back, WhatsApp and Print
must_not: A 'Cancel receipt' button for staff

steps.action: Tap 'Collect payment' in the page header
user_sees: The same collect sheet; the button shows only while money is due
must_not: 'Collect payment' shown for a member with no dues
'Collect payment' for a pass member ('No dues on a pass')

steps.action: Save the payment, tap the receipt link in Payments
user_sees: The new row under 'Payments' marked 'Paid'; the printable receipt opens
must_not: Dues tile still showing the old amount

steps.action: Tap 'Collect payment' in the page header
user_sees: The same collect sheet; the button shows only while money is due

steps.action: Tap the tile (opens /money/today)
user_sees: Collections opened on today, with today's receipts only
must_not: This month's total shown under a 'today' heading

steps.action: Type an amount above the due, save
user_sees: 'That is more than the {amount} due on this membership.'
must_not: An overpayment saved
'clears all dues' shown for an amount above the due

steps.action: Type 0, then letters, save
user_sees: 'Type an amount more than zero.' / 'That amount looks wrong. Type it again.'
must_not: A zero or negative receipt

steps.action: Clear the date, or type year 0002, or pick tomorrow, save

must_not: A raw 'Not a YYYY-MM-DD date:' error

steps.action: Tap the cancel button on a receipt row
user_sees: Sheet 'Cancel this receipt?': 'Receipt {no} for {amount}, taken on {day}, will no longer count as money received. The amount is added back to this member’s dues. The receipt stays in the list, marked cancelled. Its number is never used again.'; 'Cancel receipt' stays off until a reason is typed
must_not: Cancel with no reason
The promise of dues added back when the membership is cancelled or the receipt is not for a membership

steps.action: Type the reason 'Entered twice', tap 'Cancel receipt'
user_sees: Button 'Cancelling…'
Toast; the row stays, marked 'Cancelled'; totals drop by the amount; the member is back on Dues
must_not: The receipt deleted from the list
Its number given to a later receipt
The amount still in this month's collection
A way to un-cancel that changes the saved receipt silently

start: Signed in as front desk, a saved receipt of today

steps.action: Open the member's Payments list and the receipt page
user_sees: The receipt and its 'Paid' or 'Cancelled' mark; no 'Cancel receipt' button anywhere
must_not: A greyed-out cancel button
Staff changing the amount, date or method of a saved receipt

steps.action: Collect the wrong amount by mistake, look for a way to undo it
user_sees: No undo for staff: the owner cancels the receipt
must_not: A second receipt silently replacing the first

steps.action: Type the address /money (Collections) and /expenses
user_sees: Money opens on Dues with no totals; Expenses does not open
must_not: Collections totals shown to staff
A blank page with no way back

steps.action: Tap 'Download Excel file' on each tab
user_sees: A file with only the rows on screen: 'Exported {n} receipts.' / 'Exported {n} dues.'
must_not: Rows of another gym or branch in the file
A formula run from a member's name in Excel
Phone numbers in a file the staff role can download

steps.action: Read the Dues list
user_sees: Names and each person's own due
must_not: Gym totals, profit or the cash book
An export of everyone's phone numbers
